blocks.tamil_translation: He does not utter any word except that there is with him a watcher ready (to record it).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مِنْ حُسْنِ اِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث غريب، باب حديث من حسن اسلام المرء تركه ما لا يعنيه، رقم:٢٣١٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “The excellence and completeness of a person's Islam is that he leaves what is of no concern to him,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of this hadith is that not speaking about unnecessary matters and keeping away from vain actions is a sign that Iman is complete. Further, avoiding the above-mentioned actions is a beauty and radiance for the Islam that a person has.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ﵄ عَنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ يَضْمَنْ لِيْ مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَماَ بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ اَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب حفظ اللسان، رقم:٦٤٧٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever guarantees (not to misuse the tongue and private parts) for the organs between his two jaws and between his two thighs, I guarantee Jannah for him,” Hazrat Sahl ibn Sa'd (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ ﵁ اَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ: اَخْبِرْنِيْ بِاَمْرٍ اَعْتَصِمُ بِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَمْلِكْ هذَا وَاَشَارَ اِلي لِسَانِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني باسنادين واحدهما جيد، مجمع الزوائد:٥٣٦/١٠
